image: So the ruler issues the charge,
proclaiming it to the four quarters.
lines: A lean pig, surely, stamps and stamps.
A melon wrapped in willow leaves,

notes.name_en: 姤 is an unexpected meeting/encounter; plain 'Meeting', not Wilhelm's 'Coming to Meet'.
notes.L1: 金柅 a metal cart-brake; the lean pig (羸豕) stamping (蹢躅) is the small force barely held.
notes.L4: 43 L4 repeats here in the Chinese (臀無膚其行次且); the English repeats word for word.
